from zipfile import ZipFile
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median, mean
from itertools import combinations
import re, math

class Node:
    __slots__=('name','length','children')
    def __init__(self,name=None,length=0.0):
        self.name=name; self.length=length; self.children=[]

def parse_newick(s):
    s=s.strip()
    if s.endswith(';'): s=s[:-1]
    i=0
    def token(stop):
        nonlocal i
        j=i
        while i<len(s) and s[i] not in stop: i+=1
        return s[j:i].strip()
    def subtree():
        nonlocal i
        if s[i]=='(':
            i+=1
            node=Node()
            while True:
                node.children.append(subtree())
                if i>=len(s): raise ValueError('unterminated')
                if s[i]==',': i+=1; continue
                if s[i]==')': i+=1; break
                raise ValueError(f'expected comma/close at {i}: {s[i:]}')
            # optional internal label then branch length
            if i<len(s) and s[i] not in ',():' :
                node.name=token(',():')
            if i<len(s) and s[i]==':':
                i+=1; node.length=float(token(',()'))
            return node
        name=token(',():')
        if not name: raise ValueError(f'empty leaf at {i}')
        node=Node(name)
        if i<len(s) and s[i]==':':
            i+=1; node.length=float(token(',()'))
        return node
    root=subtree()
    if i "'!= len(s): raise ValueError((i,s[i:]))
    return root

def pairwise(root):
    # distances by path to root; edge length is stored on child
    leaves=[]
    def walk(node,path):
        path=path+[(node, sum(x[1] for x in path[-0:] ))] if False else path
        if node.children:
            for c in node.children:
                walk(c,path+[(c,node.length)])
        else:
            # path has (child, edge length) from root to leaf, root omitted
            leaves.append((node.name,path))
    # simpler recursive with accumulated ancestor path (node, dist from root)
    def collect(node,dist,anc):
        if not node.children:
            leaves.append((node.name,anc+[(node,dist)]))
        else:
            for c in node.children:
                collect(c,dist+c.length,anc+[(node,dist)])
    leaves=[]; collect(root,0.0,[])
    out=[]
    for (n1,p1),(n2,p2) in combinations(leaves,2):
        d1={id(n):d for n,d in p1}; d2={id(n):d for n,d in p2}
        common=set(d1)&set(d2)
        # deepest common by root distance
        lca=max(common,key=lambda k:d1[k])
        out.append((n1,n2,d1[id(p1[-1][0])]+d2[id(p2[-1][0])]-2*d1[lca]))
    return leaves,out

for group in ['"'animals','fungi']:
    p=Path('inputs')/f'scogs_{group}.zip'
    rec=[]
    with ZipFile(p) as z:
        for n in z.namelist():
            if n.endswith('.treefile'):
                s=z.read(n).decode()
                root=parse_newick(s)
                leaves,dists=pairwise(root)
                vals=[d for *_,d in dists]
                rec.append((n, [x[0] for x in leaves], mean(vals), vals))
    ms=[x[2] for x in rec]
    complete=[x for x in rec if len(x[1])==4]
    msc=[x[2] for x in complete]
    print(group,'trees',len(rec),'complete',len(complete),'mean-of-tree-means',mean(ms),'median-of-tree-means',median(ms))
    print('  all pooled pairwise mean',mean([d for x in rec for d in x[3]],),'median pooled',median([d for x in rec for d in x[3]]),'pairs',sum(len(x[3]) for x in rec))
    print('  complete mean',mean(msc),'median',median(msc),'pairs',sum(len(x[3]) for x in complete))
    print('  range',min(ms),max(ms))
    print('  median neighbors',sorted(ms)[len(ms)//2-1:len(ms)//2+1] if len(ms)%2==0 else [median(ms)])
    # print lowest/highest for spot checks
    for x in sorted(rec,key=lambda y:y[2])[:2]+sorted(rec,key=lambda y:y[2])[-2:]: print('   ',x[0].split('/')[-1],len(x[1]),repr(x[2]),x[1])
    globals()[group+'_rec']=rec

fa=median([x[2] for x in fungi_rec]); aa=median([x[2] for x in animals_rec])
fc=median([x[2] for x in fungi_rec if len(x[1])==4]); ac=median([x[2] for x in animals_rec if len(x[1])==4])
print('ratio fungi/animals all',repr(fa/aa), 'fungi',repr(fa),'animals',repr(aa))
print('ratio fungi/animals complete',repr(fc/ac), 'fungi',repr(fc),'animals',repr(ac))
print('ratio animals/fungi all',repr(aa/fa))
PY"

from zipfile import ZipFile
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, median
from itertools import combinations
import math

class Node:
    __slots__=('label','edge','children')
    def __init__(self,label=None,edge=0.0):
        self.label=label; self.edge=edge; self.children=[]

def parse_newick(text):
    s=text.strip()
    assert s.endswith(';')
    s=s[:-1]
    pos=0
    def token(stops):
        nonlocal pos
        start=pos
        while pos<len(s) and s[pos] not in stops: pos+=1
        return s[start:pos].strip()
    def node():
        nonlocal pos
        if s[pos]=='(':
            pos+=1; x=Node()
            while True:
                x.children.append(node())
                if s[pos]==',': pos+=1
                elif s[pos]==')': pos+=1; break
                else: raise AssertionError(s[pos:])
            if pos<len(s) and s[pos] not in ',():': x.label=token(',():')
            if pos<len(s) and s[pos]==':': pos+=1; x.edge=float(token(',()'))
            return x
        x=Node(label=token(',():'))
        if pos<len(s) and s[pos]==':': pos+=1; x.edge=float(token(',()'))
        return x
    root=node()
    assert pos==len(s),(pos,s[pos:])
    return root

def graph_distances(root):
    graph={}; lookup={}; leaves=[]
    def visit(x):
        lookup[id(x)]=x; graph[id(x)]=[]
        if not x.children: leaves.append(x)
        for c in x.children:
            visit(c)
            graph[id(x)].append((id(c),c.edge))
            graph[id(c)].append((id(x),c.edge))
    visit(root)
    assert all(x.label and math.isfinite(x.edge) and x.edge>=0 for x in leaves)
    out=[]
    for a,b in combinations(leaves,2):
        seen={id(a):0.0}; stack=[a]
        while stack:
            cur=stack.pop()
            for nxt,w in graph[id(cur)]:
                if nxt not in seen:
                    seen[nxt]=seen[id(cur)]+w
                    stack.append(lookup[nxt])
        assert id(b) in seen
        out.append(seen[id(b)])
    return leaves,out

summaries={}
for group,expected in (('animals',100),('fungi',249)):
    per_tree=[]
    with ZipFile(Path('inputs')/f'scogs_{group}.zip') as z:
        names=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.treefile')]
        assert len(names)==expected
        for name in names:
            leaves,dist=graph_distances(parse_newick(z.read(name).decode()))
            assert len(leaves)>=3 and all(math.isfinite(x) for x in dist)
            per_tree.append(mean(dist))
    summaries[group]=median(per_tree)
    print(group,'n',len(per_tree),'median',format(summaries[group],'.17g'))
ratio=summaries['fungi']/summaries['animals']
print('ratio',format(ratio,'.17g'))
assert abs(ratio-1.947482109191807)<1e-12
PY"
